_readme: Every word in the site's emails. Wording approved in LJF_Akshat_Point_by_Point_Answers_18_Nov_2026.pdf (A3.2, A3.3, A3.5 and 'Email templates for immediate implementation'). Placeholders: {firstName} {service} {city} {inCity} {date} {window} {address} {phone}. Do not add response times, opening hours, prices, cancellation or payment terms unless separately agreed.

brand.footer: Live Junk Free · Junk removal, cleanouts and demolition in Toronto and the GTA · 647-922-5865 · livejunkfree.ca

acknowledgement.subject: We received your Live Junk Free enquiry
acknowledgement.preheader: Thanks for contacting Live Junk Free.
paragraphs: Thanks for contacting Live Junk Free about {service}{inCity}. We’ve received your request and our team will review the details and contact you to discuss next steps and pickup availability.
If you’d like to reach us sooner, call 647-922-5865.
Please note: submitting an enquiry or selecting a preferred callback time does not confirm a pickup appointment.

confirmed.subject: Your Live Junk Free pickup is confirmed — {date}
confirmed.intro: Following our conversation, your pickup is confirmed with the following details:
confirmed.closing: If anything needs to change, please call 647-922-5865 or reply to this email.
